purpose: Every playable asset belongs to one causal gameplay graph. Media and UI remain visually separate but are never logically independent.

scene_contract.sceneId: stable identity of the current playable situation
scene_contract.mediaId: clean image/video rendered for that scene
scene_contract.choices: each choice references sceneId and source mediaId
scene_contract.consequence: references the selected choiceId and source sceneId
scene_contract.resume: next scene references consequenceId and may reuse a captured continuity frame

invariants: No playable media without sceneId and mediaId.
A clean video never contains gameplay UI, but its mediaId binds it to the overlay.
Character, location, chronology, wardrobe and relationship context travel with the scene identity.
Branch generation must preserve continuity from the exact source scene/media whenever appropriate.
